decision: Base = 'IS300 Full Car.stl' (2026, 1-v5mBT5upzAlgA3L26viXBjJdrpRtLVc); 'Squire Edition' (2022) not used
why: Squire Edition sits 1.5 mm median from the 2026 file (82 % within 5 mm) - same car, same frame; the 2026 export is the newest. Dash/Interior/Headlight/Sake Wave not needed for a body reel

decision: One levelling transform (projects/lexus-is300/tools/level.py -> /home/user/media/work/is300/level.json): PCA long axis -> Y nose at -Y, greenhouse up, tilt refined on the four tyre patches (2.9 deg); every part gets the same R,t; then ive prep car (mm->m, centre, floor) and parts --like car.json
why: Raw Artec frame has the car lying diagonally (up ~ raw +Y); one shared rigid transform + --like keeps every state registered (lessons: never re-normalise a part)

decision: Part/state scans (2022-23 sessions) registered to the 2026 car with FPFH+RANSAC + multi-scale point-to-plane ICP (tools/register.py, transforms in /home/user/media/work/is300/reg/*.json)
why: They are NOT in the full car's frame (median 37-180 mm off). Rear bumper and side skirt: 5/5 starts agree (rmse 3.1 mm); after alignment medians 4.0/4.9 mm to the 4 mm car (noise floor) and a further ICP only slides along the skin. Red-over-silver renders (chk/sheet1.jpg) sit exactly on the bumper and sill

decision: 'front end bumper removed' accepted as registered
why: Overlap only 17 % (bumper off exposes the FMIC, radiator, crash structure), but where it overlaps (headlights, fender, wheel) median 3-5 mm and red z-fights the car's headlights/fender in the overlay render; extra ICP moves it 5 mm/0.13 deg with no gain

decision: Rear Trunk Open, OEM Trunk and Side Skirt Under registered and accepted
why: Rear Trunk Open: 4/5 global starts agree, rmse 3.2 mm, red z-fights quarters/tail lamps/wheel (chk/sheet5). Side Skirt Under: 5/5 agree, rmse 2.4 mm. OEM Trunk (lone lid, own frame) failed on the whole car (78 deg, inconsistent) - re-registered against the rear-deck zone only: 4/4 agree, fitness 0.59, rmse 2.35 mm, z-fights the lid (chk/sheet6)

decision: Front bumper cover derived from the data = full car minus the registered 'front end bumper removed' state (tools/front_bumper.py: >10 mm from the state, below the state's own top surface, z < -60 mm centre / -280 mm outboard of the lamps)
why: No separate front-bumper part scan exists; the difference of the two registered states IS the bumper. Lamp-zone cutoff stops the headlight bezels and hood nose from flying off with it (chk/sheet4)

decision: Trunk lid = car tris on the rear deck behind the hinge line (y>1565 mm levelled, z>250) within the OEM lid's width, plus the car's skin within 12 mm of the OEM lid scan's rear face, minus the rear bumper (tools/trunk_lid.py); hinge = lid front edge at the rear-window base
why: OEM Trunk scan is only the lid's rear face with a ragged top, so it can't be the animated panel; the car's own lid carries the spoiler lip and matches the car exactly. Centreline profile: window slope ends at y~1560, deck 306-334 mm, rear face drops at y 1950

decision: Panels-off composites with the shared ferrari-296 composite.py: comp_front (car - front bumper + bumper-removed state), comp_trunk (car - lid + Rear Trunk Open below z 300 mm, dropping its propped-lid fragment), comp_explode (car - front bumper, rear bumper, right side skirt, lid + all three states)
why: Lessons: state scans as captured over the full car trimmed back; parts land back exactly where they were cut out. Rear Trunk Open is also the rear-bumper-off state (bumper beam, trunk floor), so the rear bumper can leave too

decision: Music = lexus-is300_track.mp3 (original late-90s boom-bap generated for this reel by the coordinating session, ElevenLabs via Higgsfield); 40.05 s file, music ends ~31.4 s then decays to silence ~37.5 s
why: Brief: use the track sent by the parent session, no other music. Per-0.5 s RMS: 0.45 at 30 s, 0.22 at 32, 0.06 at 35, 0.007 at 37.5, digital silence after ~39

decision: Beat grid 92.0 BPM (0.6522 s), anchored on the kick: least-squares/brute fit of 40-120 Hz flux, phase 0.050 s. ive beats agrees (92.3 BPM, 0.65 s)
why: Lesson (FG2): anchor on kick peaks, not the first spectral-flux onset

decision: Cuts on kick beats: 0 / 8 (5.27) / 14 (9.18) / 16 DROP (10.49) / 20 (13.09) / 26 (17.01) / 32 (20.92) / 36 (23.53) / logo 48 (31.36); explode separates on beat 36, locks on beat 46 (30.05 s, the last hit, end of the 28.75-29.40-30.05 triple), holds 2 beats
why: Intro (0-10.4) has kicks on even beats at ~1/3 level; drop at 10.485 doubles the energy - the detail montage lands on it. Holds vary 2-12 beats (lesson: vary holds). Last percussive hit is 30.05 s, so the reassembly slams home there and the logo sits on the tail, as the parent session asked

decision: Shot order: front 3/4 turntable (8 beats) -> rear 3/4 orbit (6) -> wheel close-up (2) -> headlight/grille (4, on the drop) -> front bumper off (6) -> trunk opens (6) -> top-down (4) -> exploded view (12) -> logo to ~37.4 s
why: Brief: Temerario order; hood has no open-state scan, so 'panels open' = front bumper off (state scan) and trunk lid (Rear Trunk Open state)

decision: Framing tightened after 30 % stills (chk/stills1.jpg): turntables 5.0 -> 4.0 m, bumper-off 4.6 -> 3.7 m, trunk 4.7 -> 4.1 m; explode changed from a far 3/4 orbit to a side-on view from the right with panels stacked ABOVE the car (skirt +0.55, bumpers +1.05, lid +1.55 m)
why: Car read small in 9:16 and exploded parts flew out of frame; lessons (240SX/Huracan): crop into the car, stack parts vertically, never toward the lens; Temerario 25-31 s floats panels in layers above the car

decision: Exploded view camera: steep high rear-right (~57 deg down), nose at the TOP of the 9:16 frame, slow 26 deg orbit; front bumper out -0.85 m/up 0.35, rear bumper +0.75/up 0.45, right skirt out 0.6/up 0.35, lid up 0.9 m tipped 15 deg; staggered 0.08-0.16 s
why: Side-on view (2nd try, chk/x1.jpg) showed the bumpers edge-on as slivers and drifted them out of frame; diagonal 3/4 (chk/x2.jpg) clipped the lid/bumper at the frame edge. Nose-up high view puts the car's length + both bumper gaps along the 9:16 height and shows bumper faces, lid and the exposed trunk/FMIC (chk/x3.jpg)

decision: Top-down (s7) now rises from high FRONT-left and lands nose-DOWN; explode opens nose-UP from behind
why: Old s7 ended on almost the same frame the explode starts on - would read as a repeated shot (FG2 lesson: never reuse a shot/angle)

decision: Front bumper lifts up 0.45 m and forward 0.55 m in the bumper-off shot, camera near-frontal (-24 -> -10 deg)
why: First version slid it 0.85 m sideways-forward out of the 9:16 frame; lifting keeps it in frame and uncovers the FMIC/radiator from the state scan

decision: All shots rendered at -0.5 EV (tools/shot.py = copy of the ferrari-296 renderer + an exposure field)
why: 0 EV top-down frame: car median luma 221 / p90 241, roof reads as white clay; -0.5 EV gives 201-211 / 235 vs the Temerario reference ~200 / 231 (Huracan session measured the same). Copied rather than edited the sibling's tool: brief keeps each session in its own project
Frame-diff on v1 assembly showed every cut 2 frames early (156 vs 158): first clip must be one frame short of the first cut frame (158-1), not three

decision: v2 opening: s1_wide/s2_rear whole car in frame (r 7.4-8.4 m vs 3.8-4.0 in v1), fade up from black, slow push with <10 deg rotation
why: User: car is clipped at the beginning; sibling v1 notes (opening too cropped) and lesson: rotations waste screen time; Temerario wide shots have the car at ~60-70 % width

decision: v2 explode = one global part timeline (video s) seen through section close-ups: s5 front corner (bumper forward, beat 21), s6 high over the open front end (FMIC/radiator), s7 rear-left (rear bumper back 30.5, lid up 31), s8 low right sill (skirt out 34.5), s9 high diagonal wide: all out, home from 42.5, LOCK on 46
why: User: focus on specific sections better / same first-draft issues as the other cars (explode too wide, not zoomed into part assemblies). Lessons: front first then rear, parts into clear black on straight axes, no spins (no useful backsides)

decision: Dropped v1 s6_trunk (hinged lid) and s7_top (rotating top-down)
why: Trunk opening now happens inside the rear section close-up (s7_rear); rotating top-down was a wasted rotation (miata lesson); s9 high diagonal covers the overhead view

decision: Kept v1 renders s3_wheel and s4_nose
why: Already section close-ups (wheel, headlight/grille) on the same beats

decision: Ending: s9 fades to black over 0.5 s, then small logo (380 px, ~35 % width) fades in on black
why: Temerario reference and sibling v2s: fade to black, small logo; v1 used an 860 px logo with a hard cut

decision: s1_wide r 8.2->7.6 aimed 0.4 m toward the nose, s2_rear r 8.0->7.5 aimed 0.4 m toward the tail; s6_core pulled back (bumper fully in frame); s8_side camera raised to 1.5 m looking down on the sill
why: Measured on 30 % stills: car 68-78 % of width with >=9 % margin each side on every frame (v1 s1: 100 %, touching both edges; first v2 try at r 6.5 still touched the right edge because the near end dominates). s8 at 0.6 m hid the skirt's outward slide

decision: Licence plates flattened in the geometry (tools/plate.py) on car, car2, fbumper (front) and lid (rear): verts in the plate box within 15 mm of the plate's robust plane projected onto it; all shots that show a plate re-rendered (s1, s2, s4_nose, s5-s9)
why: User (via parent): plate should be blurred, IS300 only. Geometry fix instead of a post blur: no tracking across 8 moving shots and the part moves; composites skipped because their boxes hold the intercooler face and the open trunk (checked depth maps). Verified blank at 60 mm close-ups (chk/plates.jpg)

decision: v2 rebuilt per direction.md (scene-director + parent's all-reels brief/addendum): s1_wide 0-8, s3_wheel 8-10, s4_nose 10-14, s5_front HERO 14-24 (bumper off on the drop, push in on the intercooler, front-right corner), s6_side 24-30 (skirt), s7_rear 30-38 (rear bumper back + tipped to show its scanned inside, lid lifts off the Rear Trunk Open state), s8_finale 38-48 (top-down, parts lift on beat 40, land on hits 44/45/46, rear-left 3/4, fade), small logo
why: User: consistently poorly cropped, redundant shots of the same section, bumper-removed data must be highlighted/labelled/shown in detail, order by scan features, front->side->rear travel; one sequence per section; draft s2_rear (second whole-car shot, ping-pong) and s6_core (same subject as s5) cut/merged

decision: Rear bumper tipped -110 deg about X; skirt and front bumper translate only
why: Back-side stills (chk/backs.jpg): rear bumper part scan has a clean scanned inside with mounting tabs; skirt back reads edge-on/noise; front bumper is a derived outer skin

decision: Framing fixed from key-beat stills (chk/v3_stills.jpg, v3_s8b.jpg): s5 end pulled back (bumper was cut at the edge), s6 camera higher/looking down the sill, s7 more directly behind (car clipped right, lid at top edge), s8 camera stays high until beat 44 then descends (parts clipped mid-swing)
why: Addendum A: nothing clipped by accident; checked first/mid/last + key beats of every new shot

decision: Renderer: persistent data off; specs render 3 extra tail frames
why: All-reels brief: lighting dropouts with persistent data in animated shots (ferrari-296); minterpolate tail freeze (subaru lesson)

decision: Reused renders s1_wide/s3_wheel/s4_nose played at src_fps (N-1)/(dur+0.1) = 14.81 / 14.29 / 14.44
why: Subaru lesson: minterpolate leaves a ~3-frame freeze at the end of each clip when the source has no tail frames; a 1-5 % slower move is invisible

decision: Re-framed s5/s6/s7/s8 and changed front bumper move to drop down+0.5 m forward (was 0.8 m toward camera)
why: first v2 final contact sheets: front bumper filled and clipped the frame (s5 f50-80), skirt ran off the right edge (s6), rear bumper clipped left (s7), lid/bumper clipped right mid-swing (s8); addendum A says nothing clipped

decision: s5 end target shifted to car's right, s8 camera higher/further during the reassembly swing
why: check stills: s5 last frame touched left edge, s8 frames 35-69 clipped the rear bumper at bottom/right; re-check all edges at background level

decision: s1_wide re-rendered as a real orbit (-26 to -58 deg, r 8.6->9.0) instead of the near-static push
why: ive director measured s1 as 5.1 s of dead frames (motion 0.22); brief says open on the whole car WITH motion from frame 1; margins checked on stills (14-25 %)

decision: Kept s5_front/s7_rear despite director 'repeated view' flag; kept 0.9 s settled hold at end of s8
why: s5 and s7 are the two opposite ends of the car (front bumper/intercooler vs rear bumper/trunk) - same composition on purpose so the sections read as a pair, not the same view; s8 hold lets the reassembled car land before the fade
